expectations.text: Processing only on the controller's documented instructions (Art. 28(3)(a)), including for transfers
expectations.evidence: Clause 3: "only on your documented instructions, including regarding international transfers"

expectations.text: Confidentiality commitments for persons authorised to process (Art. 28(3)(b)) and Art. 32 security measures (Art. 28(3)(c))
expectations.evidence: Clause 4: confidentiality obligations for all authorized persons; Clause 5: Art. 32 measures - encryption, access controls, logging, testing

expectations.text: Sub-processor rules: prior specific or general written authorisation, notification of changes, and flow-down of equivalent obligations (Art. 28(2), (4))
expectations.evidence: Clause 6: "General or specific prior written authorization... notification mechanism... right to object... flow-down obligation... processor remains fully liable"

expectations.text: Assistance obligations: data subject rights requests and Arts. 32–36 (security, breach notification, DPIA) assistance (Art. 28(3)(e), (f)), with processor breach notification to the controller without undue delay (Art. 33(2))
expectations.evidence: Clauses 7-9: assistance with data subject requests and Art. 32-36; "notification to you without undue delay" with 24-72h outer limit and Art. 33(3)-style content

expectations.text: End-of-contract deletion or return of data, and audit/inspection rights including information necessary to demonstrate compliance (Art. 28(3)(g), (h))
expectations.evidence: Clause 10: delete or return at your choice incl. backups; Clause 11: "make available all information necessary to demonstrate compliance and allow for/contribute to audits, including inspections"
